summary: Join our Climate Change Training Course to learn vital resilience and adaptation techniques. Empower yourself to tackle climate challenges head-on!
lede: Climate resilience training helps sustainability, risk, facilities and operations professionals assess climate exposure and turn priority risks into adaptation actions. Participants practise screening hazards such as heat, flooding, drought and storms, assessing vulnerability and adaptive capacity, comparing adaptation options, and developing costed implementation plans with monitoring indicators for assets, services, programmes and supply chains.
audienceIntro: This course is built for professionals who need to assess climate exposure, decide where adaptation action matters most, and turn resilience plans into implementation-ready outputs.
prerequisites: Recommended prerequisites: working knowledge of organisational risk, operations, sustainability, asset management, or programme delivery; no programming is required. Familiarity with basic spreadsheet analysis and report writing will help you complete the exercises faster. The course uses practical templates, climate risk matrices, and planning tools, so you should be prepared to work with case data, prioritisation criteria, and adaptation planning outputs during the sessions.
